items.name: Huldra-Hair Bracelet
items.lore: A braid of hair, golden and impossibly fine. It smells of pine and cream.

items.name: Hallvard's Axe-Ring
items.lore: An iron ring forged from the head of a woodsman's axe.

items.name: Birch-Bark Sash
items.lore: Huldu work: strips of birch bark woven soft as cloth.

items.name: Grima's Hearth Cloak
items.lore: Grey wool with a red border. Old Grima's best. She insisted.

items.name: Gormr's Collar
items.lore: A wide studded collar, worn smooth by a big dog's neck.

items.name: Broken Bone-Fetish
items.lore: A vendo shaman's charm, snapped and bound with red thread. The curse is out of it. Mostly.

items.name: Houndmaster's Belt
items.lore: Hung with whistles, leads and treats. Every hound in Mularn knows it.

items.name: Spring-Water Ring
items.lore: Silver from the bottom of a cleansed spring. It is always cold.

items.name: Prankster's Bell Charm
items.lore: A hobgoblin's bell. It still jingles at the worst moments.

items.name: Mularn Watch Ring
items.lore: Plain iron, stamped with the hall's mark.

items.name: Ale-Keg Hoop Bracer
items.lore: A barrel hoop, bent round. It held good ale once.

items.name: Goblin-Net Sash
items.lore: Knotted from a water goblin's net. Damp, always.

items.name: Vein-Silk Cuff
items.lore: Spider silk, wound tight. It turns a knife, nearly.

items.name: Cellar-Lantern Charm
items.lore: A tiny lantern on a cord. Spiders hate it.

items.name: Snake-Finder's Ring
items.lore: A ring of snake-bone. The hobgoblins use them to find more snakes.

items.name: Haggerfel Road Cloak
items.lore: Brown wool, for the road between the two towns.

items.name: Wood-Eater Mandible Pin
items.lore: A wood-eater's jaw, made into a pin. It still clicks.

items.name: Sawdust Satchel-Belt
items.lore: A woodcutter's belt. Smells of fresh pine and something worse.

items.name: Hive-Hunter's Chitin Charm
items.lore: A plate of wood-eater shell, polished.

items.name: Alate-Wing Cloak
items.lore: Stiff, translucent, and somehow warm.

items.name: Hive-King's Crown-Plate
items.lore: A plate of the hive king's crest. It hums.

items.name: Royal-Guard Bracer
items.lore: Thick chitin, the royal guard's own.

items.name: Mularn Hearth Ring
items.lore: Given by the jarl's household, with thanks.

items.name: Milk-Pail Charm
items.lore: A tiny tin pail. The hidden folk leave these where they've been fed.

items.name: Birch-Shadow Sash
items.lore: Grey-green and hard to see in a wood.

items.name: Outcast's Tail-Ribbon
items.lore: A ribbon tied round a huldu's tail. She gave it freely.

items.name: Hidden-Path Ring
items.lore: Birch-bark, set in silver. You keep seeing paths that weren't there.

items.name: White-Stone Ring
items.lore: A pebble from the huldu ring, set in silver. Cold.

items.name: Birch-Bark Letter-Charm
items.lore: The hidden folk's letter, folded small. It doesn't open again.

items.name: Seeress's Shawl
items.lore: Grey, with the nine-knot border of Haggerfel's volur.

items.name: Phantom-Hound Collar
items.lore: A collar with no hound in it. It's still warm.

items.name: Falls-Mist Cloak
items.lore: Always slightly damp from Darkness Falls.

items.name: Wolfhound-Tooth Ring
items.lore: A fang in a band of iron.

items.name: Kennel-Master's Bracer
items.lore: Scarred leather, bitten many times.

items.name: Frost-Track Charm
items.lore: A shard of ice from the great wolf's track. It hasn't melted.

items.name: Veldon Watch Mantle
items.lore: Fort Veldon's grey, with the watch-tower in white.

items.name: Howl-Ward Torc
items.lore: Iron and rowan, against the howling.

items.name: Bone-Collector's Ring
items.lore: Finger bones on a wire. Not yours, thankfully.

items.name: Barrow-Ward Belt
items.lore: Stitched with the barrow-runes the vendo tried to dig past.

items.name: Vendo Fetish-Charm
items.lore: A shaman's fetish. Someone has painted a red eye on it.

items.name: Cave-Fur Mantle
items.lore: Thick and smoky. The vendo know how to keep warm.

items.name: Dragon-Tongue's Tract
items.lore: A scrap of red vellum. The words on it squirm.

items.name: Preacher-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Iron, plain, and heavy. Thorvald's gift.

items.name: Cavemouth Bracer
items.lore: Rough leather, scorched at the edge.

items.name: Well-Water Charm
items.lore: A drop of Haggerfel's well in glass. It shows you nothing. Yet.

items.name: Jordheim Courier's Belt
items.lore: Royal blue, with Eirik's mark.
